positions.name: MissingIdFailureGuarantees
positions.frame: what must the derive-id pipeline guarantee when a heading arrives without an id field?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere around the same end-to-end test scenario: src-1 identifies the production failure pattern being reproduced (a ## heading with no id field), and src-2 states the non-negotiable constraints the pipeline must meet in that scenario (no crash, valid slug). The shared technical register and the expert-authority footing tie them together. A conviction gradient runs across the set — src-1 is a flat claim about what the test does, src-2 is a settled decision about what must hold — but the frame holds both sides: the reproduction grounds the requirement, and the requirement defines acceptable behavior for the reproduced case.
